## Checklist

- [ ] I ran `python scripts/check_data.py` and it passed (or I let the automated check run).
- [ ] Text is correct in both French and English, where both exist.
- [ ] Any photo of an identifiable person may legally be published.
- [ ] No passwords, keys, private phone numbers or home addresses in this change.
- [ ] This pull request changes only what the description says.
